artworks.title: Theseus and the Minotaur
artworks.description: Canova's marble group catches the hero at the moment of victory — the Minotaur beneath him, the labyrinth's prey finally pinned by the Athenian who came to Crete on the black-sailed ship.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Bacchus and Ariadne
artworks.description: Carracci's Farnese Gallery ceiling celebrates the fate Theseus did not share — Ariadne crowned by Dionysus, the Cretan princess immortalized while the hero sailed home with black canvas and a dead father waiting on the height.
